statement_map.email_excerpt: Your custom domain had been showing "site can't be reached" for three days, while your funnel worked on the FlexiFunnels link but not on your own domain.

Following our guidance, you deleted the old A record at your domain registrar, which pointed to an old server address and was blocking the connection, and added a CNAME record using the target value from your FlexiFunnels domain settings.
The dashboard then showed your domain as connected and you confirmed it loads.
Following our guidance, you deleted a second record for the www version that pointed somewhere else and added a CNAME record for www with the same target value.
You confirmed that both your domain and the www version now load your funnel.
The padlock for the secure certificate can take some time to appear after connecting.
We will check that the secure certificate has been issued, and we will message you if it has not.
We will do this on the morning after our call.
